entries.speaker: Student with Ribbon in Hair
entries.uk: Будь ласка, сідайте на моє місце.

entries.speaker: Student with Ribbon in Hair
entries.en: I mean— Excuse me, that seat was for[n]this lady...
entries.uk: Тобто... Перепрошую, це місце було для[n]цієї пані...

entries.speaker: Student with Ribbon in Hair
entries.en: It's all right. I can understand his[n]position as well.
entries.uk: Нічого страшного. Я можу зрозуміти[n]і його.

entries.speaker: Student with Ribbon in Hair
entries.en: I'm sorry I couldn't be any help.

entries.speaker: Old Woman
entries.en: It's all right, dearie. Don't you worry.

entries.speaker: Student with Ribbon in Hair
entries.en: Please allow me to carry your luggage,[n]at least.

entries.speaker: Student with Ribbon in Hair
entries.en: Not at all! I train plenty.
